sources.anthropic: Anthropic first-party API pricing (claude-api reference table cached 2026-10-06, prompts <=100K tokens)

pricing.disclaimer: Costs are estimates computed from token usage and list prices; they are not provider billing data.

metadata.methodology: Counterfactual replay: each policy picks a model per prompt; outcome = that model's recorded, scored output for that prompt. Latency = recorded provider wall-clock latency of the chosen model (excludes gateway overhead, measured separately). Costs are token usage x list price (estimates).

limitations: Single dataset version (840 prompts, 161 held-out test prompts); category priors dominate the routing signal.
Task categories are trivially identifiable from their fixed instructions; real traffic is more heterogeneous.
Summaries graded by an LLM judge (gpt-4.1); judge is not ground truth (see docs/EVALUATION.md).
Costs are list-price estimates, not billing data. Latencies reflect one region/time window.
